name: shop.photosweat/remove-background
title: Photo Sweat Shop Image Tools
description: Cutout, upscale, erase and colorize photos over MCP. 10 free credits/day, then $0.01 per credit.

tools.name: colorize
tools.description: Colorizes black-and-white photos, with face enhancement on by default; already-colour photos are not recoloured and not charged (the result is still a JPEG, long edge ≤1024 px). Takes about 8 s on a warm GPU (beta — no SLA). Returns the processed image in an image content block as a JPEG whose long edge is at most 1024 px — a larger input comes back scaled down. Free tiers: 10 credits/day per anonymous IP, 30/day with a key; this tool costs 1 credits (1 credit = $0.01) beyond that. The quota left is echoed in the result text. A job that outruns the wait comes back as a status_url to poll.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Use a hostname, not an IP literal.

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). A data-URI prefix (RFC 2397) is accepted. Provide either this or image_url.

wait.description: Seconds to block waiting for the result (1–25). Past 25 the honest answer is a 202 + status_url you poll yourself, because MCP hosts time tool calls out.

face.description: On by default: restores faces after colorizing without reshaping them; up to 8 faces, small faces get smoother. Send false to skip

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Cut out the subject onto transparency, white, or any solid color. Takes about 10 s on a warm GPU. Returns the processed image in an image content block, at the input's pixel size by default (long edge clamped to 4096 px — a larger input comes back scaled down). Pass fillRatio (1-100) to crop to the subject and centre it on a square canvas, the subject's longest side taking that share of the canvas; longEdge sets the canvas side in px, 0 derives it from fillRatio. Free tiers: 10 credits/day per anonymous IP, 30/day with a key; this tool costs 1 credits (1 credit = $0.01) beyond that. The quota left is echoed in the result text.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Use a hostname, not an IP literal.

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). A data-URI prefix (RFC 2397) is accepted. Provide either this or image_url.

wait.description: Seconds to block waiting for the result (1–25). Past 25 the honest answer is a 202 + status_url you poll yourself, because MCP hosts time tool calls out.

background.description: Transparent, white, or a custom color

format.description: JPEG is much smaller for opaque backgrounds; transparency requires PNG

fillRatio.description: Longest bbox side as a share of the square canvas; 0 = no framing

longEdge.description: Square canvas side; 0 = derive from fill ratio, no resampling

verifyText.description: OCR before/after to report dropped text; slow (4-30 s), never blocks output

tools.name: upscale
tools.description: Real-ESRGAN upscale; prefer 2x on text-heavy images. Takes about 46 s on a warm GPU (beta — no SLA). Returns the processed image in an image content block, at the input's pixel size by default (long edge clamped to 4096 px — a larger input comes back scaled down). 'scale' is nominal: the output's long edge is min(scale × the input's, 4096 px). Free tiers: 10 credits/day per anonymous IP, 30/day with a key; this tool costs 2 credits (1 credit = $0.01) beyond that. The quota left is echoed in the result text. A job that outruns the wait comes back as a status_url to poll.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Use a hostname, not an IP literal.

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). A data-URI prefix (RFC 2397) is accepted. Provide either this or image_url.

wait.description: Seconds to block waiting for the result (1–25). Past 25 the honest answer is a 202 + status_url you poll yourself, because MCP hosts time tool calls out.

engine.description: Pick x4plus for text-heavy images: less halo and stroke adhesion

face.description: On by default: restores faces after upscaling without reshaping them; about +1s per face, up to 8 faces. Send false to skip

verifyText.description: Optional: OCR before/after and report missing or changed text. ~+5s on sparse text, up to +30s when text is dense
